title: Koala reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- koala body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='22' ry='16' fill='#8a9099'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='20' fill='#a8aeb8'/>

  <circle cx='30' cy='26' r='11' fill='#a8aeb8'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='26' r='11' fill='#a8aeb8'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='26' r='6' fill='#e8c4d0'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='26' r='6' fill='#e8c4d0'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='14' ry='12' fill='#c9ced6'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#5a5f68'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42.5' rx='2.5' ry='1.8' fill='#9aa0aa'/>

  <circle cx='42' cy='36' r='3' fill='#3a3f48'/>

  <rect x='50' y='66' width='22' height='26' rx='3' fill='#f2f2f8'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='66' x2='50' y2='92' stroke='#b83c3c' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='72' x2='68' y2='72' stroke='#c9ced6' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='78' x2='68' y2='78' stroke='#c9ced6' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='84' x2='64' y2='84' stroke='#c9ced6' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- paws over book -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='70' r='4' fill='#a8aeb8'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='70' r='4' fill='#a8aeb8'/>
</svg>
